column3: Close to the Hebrew; “on My anger” is rendered “a provocation of My anger.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make pass through” is rendered “pass through the fire.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in faithfulness” is rendered “assuredly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “speaking” is rendered “promised.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Shephelah” is rendered “the lowland,” and “turn back their captivity” “cause their captives to return.”
